message.content:
This is granite, so heading 6802 applies (worked monumental or building stone), not 2515 or 2516 for crude or roughly trimmed stone. The slabs are polished and beveled and will be cut to size later, so they are worked beyond simple sawing.

Subheading 6802.93 covers granite, other than monumental or building stone of 6802.10, which is tiles and cubes under 7 cm. Within it:
- 6802.93.00 is "Granite: Other: Polished or otherwise worked."
- The 10-digit statistical suffixes are 6802.93.0010 for "Slabs" and 6802.93.0090 for "Other".

The HTSUS also has 6802.91 (marble, travertine, alabaster) and 6802.92 (other calcareous stone), which don't apply. Granite falls under 6802.93, and the statistical line in 6802.93.00 is probably 6802.93.0010, "Over 0.5 m² ... slabs" or similar. I recall the tariff text as "6802.93.00 Granite", with 6802.93.0010 "Over 1 m²... " and 6802.93.0020. I'm not certain of the exact breakdown, but the item is a large slab and 6802.93.0010 is the best choice.
